notes: Bikes, ramps and 'amazing physics' with money earned for tricks and playtime looks like Racing until you apply Racing's own boundary rule: there is no lap and no finish line here, which makes it a vehicle/physics Simulation instead, so no second genre is doing real work. The author asked for one big desert freestyle compound rather than an open world, and Simulation's world-open is exactly that shared persistent riding ground with no per-player plot, so I kept the Physics Sim preset's shape and its physics-rig, which is literally ramps and breakable assemblies as the entertainment. I dropped the preset's hazard-kill since nothing in the prompt punishes leaving the riding area, and kept path-circulation for the dirt tracks chaining the ramps, the garage and the build plot together. Deciding without a user: the in-world garage where players pick and customize bikes is an enterable interior, hence building-interior and P3, and the set-aside plot for building custom ramps has no option ID in this genre so it is carried here as an extra — buildable ground beside the compound, not a grid of per-player plots.
